verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox environment that mirrors production but runs on test data, so integrations can be validated without financial risk. It also documents a dedicated simulation endpoint (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) that gives consistent pay-in and payout simulation across all customer accounts, and recommends sandbox testing before going live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior and parity with production.
